d: The Clinical Supply Chain Warehouse Coordinator will oversee inbound warehouse activities, supplier coordination, inventory receiving, and non-conformity resolution. The role ensures accurate documentation, compliance with warehouse procedures, and timely resolution of delivery and quality issues.
q: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Logistics, Finance, or a related discipline.
Minimum 7 years of supply chain management experience.
At least 3 years of relevant experience in warehouse/store management, vendor coordination, and NCR handling within the healthcare sector in Qatar's government sector.
Minimum 5 years of hands-on Oracle ERP experience and basic knowledge of WMS.
Strong understanding of end-to-end supply chain and warehouse operations.
Knowledge of inventory, warehouse, and store management.
Hands-on experience with Oracle Inventory module.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel for reporting and data analysis.
Good vendor coordination, communication, and organizational skills.
Excellent command of written and spoken English.
r: Coordinate with warehouse teams and suppliers on inbound medical consumable deliveries.
Monitor Advance Shipping Notices (ASN), delivery discrepancies, and Non-Conformity Reports (NCRs).
Manage shortages, excess deliveries, substitutions, brand or quality issues, and expiry-related concerns.
Coordinate supplier returns, replacements, and alternative shipments when required.
Verify inbound deliveries to ensure compliance with approved specifications and requirements.
Monitor product shelf life and maintain tracking records for supplier undertaking letters and replacements.
Coordinate the inspection and condemnation of expired or damaged inventory.
Monitor warehouse transactions and ensure compliance with established procedures.
Support new storage facility setups, periodic cycle counts, and annual stock counts.
Coordinate with storekeepers and relevant stakeholders to resolve warehouse and inventory issues.
